I paid $100 to have my cat professionally groomed, and when I picked her up, she was still drenched and had bird seed/debris all over her fur. I was honestly shocked that they considered her “finished” and called me to pick her up in that condition.
When I questioned the gentleman at the front desk, he blamed the carrier and said it was dirty. That was simply not true. I had purchased the carrier the day before and wiped it down just minutes before bringing my cat in because we had come directly from the veterinarian next door.
Instead of apologizing or taking responsibility, he told me they could take her to the back and “dry her a little more.” For $100, my cat should have been completely dry, clean, and properly groomed before I was ever told she was ready.
What bothered me most was the lack of accountability and customer service. Mistakes can happen, but the way you handle them matters. I left feeling like my concerns were dismissed instead of addressed. I expected a professional grooming service, and that is not what I received.

Pets store

This pet shop is NOT what it used to be. They used to be owned by a lovely couple who always went above and beyond for customers, now its new people who push way too hard to sell you anything, even if its a "companion" for your current pet or items you're not interested in purchasing.
There used to a sitting/ waiting area inside, but that was taken out. Now you either stand the whole time, bring your own chair or wait outside, even in the winter.
As far as the groomers, i used to pay $60 for a wash, haircut and nail trimming. Today i had to pay $120.
Last time i was here, the groomer did not properly trim the nails, leaving jagged edges which scratched my 4 year old daughter. When i mentioned this today, they asked if i "fixed" it at home with a nail filer. Why would i have to do that if i paid for a complete service?
This is my full opinion and experience with this business and i hope it helps others make the best decisions for their pets.

I visited this puppy store and had a terrible experience. I saw an employee cleaning cages with harsh chemicals, trapping toxic fumes inside, and the poor puppies were inhaling them. Many puppies also had poop all over their fur. When I asked about prices, I was told nothing over the phone, and after traveling four hours, I found out the puppies were $2,500—far more than expected. The prices posted outside were misleading, and when we questioned them, they denied it and tried to make up prices on the spot. It was clear that these puppies were being sold for profit with little care for their well-being. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
